$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-whatsapp-cloud-api-source). Seeds the pre-built `whatsapp-cloud-api` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's WhatsAppProviderClient (Meta-primary leg). The Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (Graph) authenticates with an `Authorization: Bearer {system-user-token}` request header; the Phone-Number-ID appears in the send path (`/{PhoneNumberID}/messages`). MOCK MODE (integration-mock-mode): ships with `configuration.mock:true` + a realistic `configuration.mockResponse` (Meta Cloud API `/{PhoneNumberID}/messages` shape, a mock `wamid.MOCK0001` message id) and isEnabled:true, so the dispatch leaf is demonstrably functional end-to-end WITHOUT a Meta system-user token — the OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter short-circuits the mock-flagged source and returns the canned success body WITHOUT sending a WhatsApp message. To go live: (1) set `configuration.headers.Authorization` to `Bearer {your-system-user-token}`; (2) the consuming app composes the `{PhoneNumberID}/messages` send path so the Phone-Number-ID is operator-supplied; (3) REMOVE `configuration.mock`. The base URL is admin-owned on the source (no SSRF surface). OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST) — template-approval gating, the 24h customer-service session window, provider selection, STOP opt-out, dedupe and delivery-status reconciliation all stay in the consuming app (pipelinq WhatsAppAdapter); this source is a pure transport.

objects.name: WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta)
objects.description: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (Graph v19.0). Consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (POST a template or free-form WhatsApp message). Dormant placeholder — the base URL is the production Meta Graph endpoint; set `configuration.headers.Authorization` to `Bearer {system-user-token}` and enable. Send path is `{PhoneNumberID}/messages` (JSON body `messaging_product:whatsapp`). Template approval state is read via `{WABA-ID}/message_templates`.
